title: Amaka
brief: Big Bar's men have Amaka. They want the ledger for her, on the Third Lagoon Bridge, alone.
standout: A trade on the bridge that does not stay a trade.

say.speaker: The Third Lagoon Bridge
lines: Big Bar's man: The book for the girl. Come alone. Come slowly.
Amaka (far off): Tunde, no give them!

objectives.title: THE LEDGER
lines: Amaka is twenty metres away with a hand on her arm.
The ledger is the only proof there is.

options.text: Hand it over and get her back
Keep it, and fight for both

objectives.sub: Then they let her go. Then they reach for their guns anyway.
Three of them. One has a gun.
Off the bridge before they regroup
objectives.late: They caught you both on the bridge.

sayDone.speaker: Under the bridge
lines: Tunde: You called. You always call.
Tunde: Amaka. I love you. I should have said it at that stall, years ago.
Amaka: I know. I was waiting for you to catch up.
